content: The issue with trade replays, where 'REPL' is reported instead of 'NEWM' to TRAX for our active trades (which are not being archived in CMRS), is due to the RH archiving story 2323911 and is affecting the #13 fix changes. The latest ESP extract for #13 is sending replay messages of rebooked trades, updated with the original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since these are all replay messages (<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’), RH will report them as 'REPL' to TRAX. Consequently, the #13 replay messages will be rejected by TRAX as they have not been reported to TRAX before. In summary, #13 replayed trade messages, similar to other BAU replay messages, will all be rejected, rendering the #13 changes from ESP and RH ineffective.
